claude.performance_metric: net income $217.6M FY2018 (up from $65.6M FY2017); in-house platform reached 93% of portfolio (~21.6M sq ft)
claude.rationale: The slice documents successful realized integration of acquired assets onto the operating platform: the in-house asset management/leasing platform grew to operate ~21.6 million sq ft (93% of portfolio), up from 70% at the 2012 listing, with no documented product/process incoherence (p4=0). Operations were moved onto the in-house platform with no documented fracture between operations and the organization/management/culture (p5=0). Impairments ($8.9M in 2018, $13.9M in 2017) were modest asset-level MOB charges, not evidence of interface disruption, and revenue and net income grew over the window.
